titulo.alumno: «È importante che tu venga»: the subjunctive after expressions of need and wish

intro: Besides opinions, the subjunctive is compulsory with impersonal expressions that indicate necessity, importance or possibility: è importante che, è necessario che, bisogna che.

palabras.consejo: Adjective of requirement that takes the impersonal subjunctive.
Verb of preference for another subject.

texto: **È importante che** (it is important that), **è necessario che** (it is necessary that), **è meglio che** (it is better that), **bisogna che** (it is necessary that), **è possibile che** (it is possible that).
All of them are followed by **che + subjunctive**: **È necessario che tu parta** (it is necessary that you leave).

**Voglio che** (I want that), **preferisco che** (I prefer that), **desidero che** (I wish that). If the subject changes, the subjunctive is used: **Voglio che tu sia felice** (I want you to be happy).

filas.texto: It is necessary that you go.
It is important that you arrive early.
È meglio che resti a casa.
It is better that you stay at home.

frases.estudio: Domani c'è una riunione importante. È necessario che tu venga.
frases.alumno: Tomorrow there is an important meeting. It is necessary that you come.
analisis: it is necessary that you come

frases.estudio: A che ora? È meglio che arrivi prima?
frases.alumno: At what time? Is it better that I arrive first?
analisis: it is better that I arrive first

frases.estudio: Sì, alle nove. È importante che siamo tutti puntuali.
frases.alumno: Yes, at nine. It is important that we are all punctual.
analisis: è importante che siamo tutti puntuali
it is important that we are all punctual

frases.estudio: D'accordo, allora parto presto di casa.
frases.alumno: Agreed, then I'll leave home early.

pregunta.texto: What structure follows the impersonal expression «è necessario che»?

opciones.texto: che + congiuntivo
opciones.explicacion: Impersonal expressions of necessity require the subjunctive in the subordinate clause.

opciones.texto: che + gerundio
opciones.explicacion: The gerund cannot function as the main verb of a noun clause.

opciones.texto: che + participio solo
opciones.explicacion: The required modal verb conjugation is missing.

pregunta.texto: Complete with the form for tu (you) of «sapere».

frase.texto: È necessario che tu ___ la verità al responsabile.

opciones.texto: sappia
opciones.explicacion: Second person singular of the present subjunctive of «sapere».

opciones.texto: sai
opciones.explicacion: It is the informal present indicative («you know»).

opciones.texto: sapessi
opciones.explicacion: It is the imperfect subjunctive.

frase.texto: È necessario che tu vada subito.

opciones.texto: An indispensable impersonal demand that concerns the listener.
opciones.explicacion: «È necessario che» conveys an unavoidable obligation in the subjunctive.

opciones.texto: A casual suggestion with no practical importance at all.
opciones.explicacion: The adjective «necessario» denotes a compulsory character.

opciones.texto: That the person already left the office an hour ago.
opciones.explicacion: It focuses on a pending action that must be carried out straight away.

pregunta.texto: What verb form is «siamo» in this context?

frase.texto: È importante che siamo tutti puntuali.

opciones.texto: First person plural of the present subjunctive of «essere».
opciones.explicacion: The form «siamo» coincides in form with the indicative and the subjunctive for noi.

opciones.texto: An invariable past participle of the third person.
opciones.explicacion: It is a conjugated personal form of the present tense.

opciones.texto: Simple future with a probability value.
opciones.explicacion: The future of noi would be «saremo».

frase.texto: È meglio che tu prenda un taxi per arrivare puntuale

piezas.traduccion: It is better that you take a taxi to arrive on time.
piezas.explicacion: Impersonal expression with the subjunctive of «prendere».

pregunta.texto: When is the subjunctive used with the verb «volere»?

opciones.texto: When the subject of «volere» is different from the subject of the desired action.
opciones.explicacion: Voglio che tu vada (I want you to go).

opciones.texto: When the subject of both verbs is exactly the same person.
opciones.explicacion: With the same subject the direct infinitive is used: «voglio andare».

opciones.texto: Only when the sentence is formulated in the past tense.
opciones.explicacion: It applies with any tense of the main clause.

frase.texto: È possibile che il treno arrivi con qualche ___ di ritardo.

opciones.texto: minuto
opciones.explicacion: Masculine singular noun.

opciones.texto: ora
opciones.explicacion: «Hour» does not fit with «qualche minuto».

opciones.texto: secondo
opciones.explicacion: «Second» would alter the sentence.

frase.texto: Bisogna che si studi seriamente per superare la prova.

opciones.texto: A generalised need for rigorous study in order to pass.
opciones.explicacion: «Bisogna che» introduces a requirement that applies to students.

opciones.texto: That all the students have already passed the exam successfully.
opciones.explicacion: It is a warning before the exam, not a later statement.

opciones.texto: A strict prohibition on consulting manuals.
opciones.explicacion: It encourages diligent study; it is not a prohibition.
